instruction: Show me salinity profiles near the equator in June 2023
output:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.time, p.lat, p.lon, m.depth_m, m.salinity_psu
FROM profiles p JOIN measurements m ON p.profile_id=m.profile_id
WHERE p.lat BETWEEN -5 AND 5 AND DATE_PART('month', p.time)=6 AND DATE_PART('year', p.time)=2023
ORDER BY p.time, m.depth_m LIMIT 200;
